Also, the account still has only 3 credits, and a poster needs 5–10. Once you've topped up or your free credits refill, send the wording and I'll make the poster.

It also notes the account has 3 credits, below the 5-10 a poster needs, so it will wait for a top-up or refill before making the poster. The main action it requests is information from the user, so it is classified as a question.
